detail.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Make `SafeTensorsStateSource.load_tensors` cache small tensors (quantization scales) per instance and reuse `safe_open` handles, so repeated single-key lookups during HF export do not re-open the shard files.

# Changelog

- `hf_pretrained/state.py`, `SafeTensorsStateSource.__init__`: per-instance `_small_tensor_cache` (tensors with ≤ 16M elements) and `_open_handles`; both switchable via `MBRIDGE_STATE_CACHE_SMALL_TENSORS=0` / `MBRIDGE_STATE_REUSE_HANDLES=0`, threshold via `MBRIDGE_STATE_SMALL_TENSOR_NUMEL`.
- `SafeTensorsStateSource.load_tensors`: serve cached keys first; in the index-mapped path use the reused handle and cache small tensors after reading them. The glob fallback path, the `key_prefix` strictness and the returned tensors are unchanged.

Why: `export_hf_weights()` re-quantizes every FP8/MXFP4 weight against its original HF `*scale` tensor and fetches each scale through `hf_state_dict[key]` → `load_tensors([key])` → one `safe_open` of the shard per tensor. For DeepSeek-V4-Pro that is ≈150k shard opens of an 806 GB checkpoint per export. In an RL loop (verl: Megatron actor → vLLM weight refit every step) the export was 657–698 s of a 962 s step at 61 layers.

Measured on GB200 (verl, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Bridge 0.6.2 with the same change; this PR is the port to `main`):

| model | export (`update_weights`) before | after | RL step |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4-layer truncated, 8 nodes | 31–35 s | 9–12 s | – |
| 61-layer, 64 nodes | 657–698 s | 238–254 s | 962 s → 535 s |

rollout/actor log-prob agreement unchanged (Pearson 0.9994 / 0.9950 before and after). Memory: the cached scales of the full Pro checkpoint are a few hundred MB per rank.

# GitHub Actions CI

External contributor; CI needs a maintainer trigger.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) (commit is signed off)
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests? — not yet; a unit test counting `safe_open` calls for repeated `load_tensors` of the same key is easy to add if the approach is accepted (all my validation is on aarch64 GB200, no x86 CI box).
- [ ] Did you add or update any necessary documentation? — the three environment variables are documented in the code; can add to docs if wanted.
- [x] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? — no.

Open question for reviewers: whether the cache should live on the source (this PR) or on the `StateDict` wrapper.

# Additional Information

- Found while bringing up DeepSeek-V4-Pro GRPO on GB200 with verl (Megatron-Bridge backend); companion verl PRs: verl-project/verl#8234, verl-project/verl#8235.

+        assert other._small_tensor_cache == {}

inline_comments.body:
[P2] Keep caller mutations out of the cached checkpoint tensors

**Failure:** With an indexed shard containing `w.scale = torch.tensor([1.0])`, the default configuration now makes this sequence return zero:
```python
source = SafeTensorsStateSource(checkpoint_dir)
source.load_tensors(["w.scale"])["w.scale"].zero_()
value = source.load_tensors(["w.scale"])["w.scale"].item()
```
The cache stores the returned tensor itself, and the [cache-hit branch](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/state.py#L680-L687) exposes that same mutable object again. Consequently, in-place preprocessing changes subsequent reads from this disk-backed checkpoint without changing the checkpoint file. Previously, [each mapped read opened a fresh shard handle](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/535a57a215d330d1cd1e71ad00c92017c54bc9c5/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/state.py#L673-L681).

**Correction:** Keep cache-owned storage private on both insertion and retrieval. Suggested replacements, not executed:
```python
# SafeTensorsStateSource._maybe_cache, inside the existing condition:
self._small_tensor_cache[key] = tensor.clone()

# SafeTensorsStateSource.load_tensors, cache-hit assignment:
loaded_tensors[key] = cached.clone()
```
Both changes are necessary: cloning only hits leaves the first returned tensor able to poison the cache; cloning only insertion leaves later hits writable. The invariant is that changing any returned cached tensor cannot change the cache's checkpoint value.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Add a CPU regression using the one-element shard above. Mutate the first result, then mutate a cache-hit result; the following read must still equal `[1.0]` each time, with unchanged shape/dtype and no additional `safe_open` calls. Check both handle-reuse settings. Retain the existing size gate and cache-disabled behavior, and retain the separate text/vision values asserted by [test_prefix_views_do_not_modify_shared_index_or_default_source](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_text_only.py#L130-L147).

inline_comments.body:
[P2] Invalidate an incomplete shard handle before retrying

**Failure:** Every retry calls `_get_handle(file_path)`, but with reuse enabled that returns the same object and therefore the same parsed header. For example, let an index advertise `text.weight` in a shard initially containing only `text.other`. If that shard is atomically replaced with a complete shard during the first retry delay, `SafeTensorsStateSource(path, key_prefix="text.").load_tensors(["weight"])` still checks the old header on all three attempts and raises `KeyError`. The [selected-subtree guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/state.py#L691-L696) correctly prevents a fallback scan, so it cannot rescue this case. The [previous retry loop](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/535a57a215d330d1cd1e71ad00c92017c54bc9c5/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/state.py#L673-L690) reopened the shard on each attempt.

**Correction:** Retain handles after successful reads, but evict a handle when its requested keys are missing. Insert immediately after computing `still_missing`:
```python
if still_missing and self._reuse_handles:
    self._open_handles.pop(str(file_path), None)
```
This suggested change makes the next attempt construct a fresh handle; it also avoids retaining the incomplete handle after the final failed attempt. Successful repeated reads must continue reusing their handle.

**Preservation / acceptance:** Proposed CPU regression: create the indexed prefixed shard described above, disable tensor caching, and replace it with a shard containing `text.weight = ones(1)` inside a patched first `time.sleep`. Loading must return `ones(1)` after two opens; a subsequent successful read must not open again. Make glob scanning fail if invoked. An unchanged incomplete shard must still raise `KeyError`, retaining the no-unrelated-scan assertion in [test_selected_source_does_not_scan_other_shards_for_missing_tensor](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_text_only.py#L150-L158). Preserve the ordinary unprefixed fallback branch.

[NOTE] Add CPU unit coverage for the cache and handle switches

**Coverage gap:** This changes default tensor ownership and shard lifetime and adds three environment variables, but the changeset adds no tests for repeated reads, independent switches, or the threshold. The existing [mocked tensor-loading test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_state_dict.py#L220-L248) bypasses this implementation, while the [real selected-source loading test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_text_only.py#L59-L65) performs only one load. Neither protects the new reuse/cache contract.

**Correction / acceptance:** Add isolated CPU tests to [the state-source test suite](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/5f926954b002b3ddd4dc6a2485fd4d7ca7ee3cab/tests/unit_tests/models/test_hf_pretrained_state.py). Use a real tiny shard with two keys and an explicit index, and count `safe_open` constructions and `get_tensor` calls while loading `a`, `a`, then `b`. Expected `(opens, reads)` for `(cache, reuse)` are `(1,2)` for `(1,1)`, `(2,2)` for `(1,0)`, `(1,3)` for `(0,1)`, and `(3,3)` for `(0,0)`; all returned values must equal the saved tensors.

Set `MBRIDGE_STATE_SMALL_TENSOR_NUMEL=2` in a separate proposed test: a two-element tensor must enter the cache and a three-element tensor must not. Construct separate text- and vision-prefixed sources exposing the same stripped key and verify each repeatedly returns its own value. Retain empty-request `{}`, mixed cached/uncached loading, missing-key errors, and the existing prefix/revision isolation assertions. These tests need no model download or GPU and should be marked `unit`.

Pushed 5b11e93 addressing the review: cached tensors are private clones (hits return clones), the reused handle is invalidated before a retry, and the four suggested CPU tests are added (`TestSafeTensorsStateSourceCache`; 18/18 pass locally on the affected classes). Ready for a CI re-run when a vetter has a moment.

Data point from a second platform: the same patch applied as a file overlay on **H100** (Megatron-Bridge 0.6.2, verl GRPO, DeepSeek-V4-Pro 1.57 T, actor PP32 × EP8 on 64 × 8 H100, vLLM rollout TP8 × DP8 × EP64) gives a steady `update_weights` of **237–239 s per step** over 5 steps, in line with the 238–254 s reported above for GB200, and the rollout/actor log-prob Pearson stays at 0.994–0.995, i.e. the cached scales produce the same exported weights. Baseline md5 of `state.py` in the 0.6.2 wheel matched `b4323389fb26926802b6569b2de67156` before patching.

reviews.body:
<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

Completed a light, source-only review of the changed loader and its affected import/export callers and tests.

Two blocking logic regressions need correction: callers can mutate the cached checkpoint tensors, and missing-key retries reuse stale shard metadata. The new cache/handle configuration also lacks targeted unit coverage (non-blocking finding).

Tests were not executed in this read-only environment. Suggested patches and regression checks require author verification.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_safetensors_small_cache_returns_independent_tensors` — proposed; mutations of first-read and cache-hit results must not affect subsequent reads.
- `test_safetensors_retry_refreshes_incomplete_shard` — proposed; replacing an incomplete shard during the retry delay must allow the next attempt to succeed.
- `test_safetensors_cache_and_handle_switches` — proposed; verify constructor/read counts for all four cache/reuse combinations.
- `test_safetensors_cache_threshold_and_instance_isolation` — proposed; verify the inclusive threshold and independent prefix-selected sources.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

Completed a light, source-only follow-up against the previously reviewed head, checking the reported fixes, added tests, and directly affected loading contracts.

The prior findings are addressed:
- Cache insertion and cache hits now return separate storage through [cloning](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/state.py#L690-L716), preventing callers from modifying cached checkpoint values.
- Missing-key retries now [invalidate the reused handle before sleeping](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/state.py#L754-L764), allowing the next attempt to read a replaced shard.
- The added [CPU tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_state_dict.py#L586-L684) cover caller mutations, refreshed-shard retries, all four cache/reuse combinations, the inclusive threshold, and per-instance cache isolation.

No unresolved prior findings or escalation-eligible regressions were validated. This was a follow-up, not a fresh whole-PR review. Tests were not executed in this read-only environment; runtime and CI results remain unverified.

### Suggested test cases
- [`TestSafeTensorsStateSourceCache.test_small_cache_returns_independent_tensors`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_state_dict.py#L612-L621) — subsequent reads remain `1.0` after first-read and cache-hit mutations.
- [`TestSafeTensorsStateSourceCache.test_retry_refreshes_incomplete_shard`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_state_dict.py#L623-L639) — shard replacement during the delay returns `ones(2)`.
- [`TestSafeTensorsStateSourceCache.test_cache_and_handle_switches`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_state_dict.py#L641-L665) — run all four existing parameter combinations and retain their open-count assertions.
- [`TestSafeTensorsStateSourceCache.test_cache_threshold_and_instance_isolation`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8d5d1c52bc43e31dc28b3d99e20603992af63bc8/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_state_dict.py#L667-L684) — only the four-element tensor is cached, and a separate instance starts cold.
- No perf tests impacted.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.
